policy: Every v1.1 definition that reuses a v1 name (core or billing), and every v1.1 capability body that overrides a v1 body, is listed here. Each one is a replacement, and writers emit only the current shape. Each is incompatible with the v1 shape in both directions, except the declared supersets, whose reasons say 'superset of v1': AllocationShare@2 is a superset of v1 AllocationShare, never stored on its own, only inside CostAllocation@2, whose schemaVersion 2 keeps v1 and v1.1 allocations apart; core ResourceRef, Scope and Grant (ADR-0022 item 2) are supersets of v1, so every stored v1 grant, scope and resource stays valid, a v1 reader refuses the one addition (kind store) and so fails closed, and kernels match resources exactly, so the addition widens no existing authority; core AgentInstallation (ADR-0022 items 2 and 3, M3 PR-1) is a superset of v1 whose scope is the v1.1 Scope, so a store-bound installation can name its store resource and a v1 reader refuses it; and core Goal and CriteriaList (ADR-0033 item 2) are supersets of v1, so every stored v1 goal and criteria list stays valid, while a v1 reader refuses a measured criterion, a dueAt or an areaTemplateId and so fails closed. Checked by inspectDeclaredReplacements in scripts/boundary-checks.mjs; the supersets by tests/contract-versioning.test.mjs.

changes.name: ads.campaign.pause.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: executes without a second approver, so the v1 proposalRef/approvalRef input is replaced by named campaigns plus a recorded reason and optional source proposal.

changes.name: agents.installation.disable.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: governance.membership.revoke.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: governance.connection.disconnect.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: agents.release.revoke.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: control.reason replaces the v1 free-text reason and adds an optional source proposal.

changes.name: Proposal
changes.reason: Proposal@2: schemaVersion 2; per-target and total credit and cash ceilings inside the digest; server-derived irreversible, requestedBy, beneficiaries and contextTaint; partial approval and derivation. taskId is null only for a human-made Governance-domain proposal, whose requestedBy is the proposer (ADR-0018 candidate edit). A v1 proposal is not a valid Proposal@2.

changes.name: Approval
changes.reason: Approval@2: schemaVersion 2; a human reviewer only; the bound review policy, quorum, recorded decisions and effectiveAt. A v1 approval is not a valid Approval@2.

changes.name: governance.approval.decide.input
changes.reason: The decision becomes a ReviewDecisionInput bound to the exact proposal digest, with an optional target selection, solo-owner confirmation and cancel before effect, in place of the v1 DecisionRef.

changes.name: BillingAccount
changes.reason: BillingAccount@2: schemaVersion 2; a route and a mode; a Morrow-direct account is storeless (installationId and storeId null, never uninstalled), so the shop-only v1 account cannot represent it. A v1 account is not a valid BillingAccount@2.

changes.name: EntitlementSnapshot
changes.reason: EntitlementSnapshot@2: schemaVersion 2; a route and a mode; subscriptionId holds a route-matched SubscriptionKey; installation and store follow the account's rule.

changes.name: CreditGrant
changes.reason: CreditGrant@2: schemaVersion 2; a route, a mode and the PaymentKey that makes a grant unique per (route, mode, paymentKey); a Shopify grant is always included.

changes.name: AllocationShare
changes.reason: AllocationShare@2: installationId and storeId are both null for a storeless Morrow-direct payer, or both set for a Shopify payer; v1 required both. It is a superset of v1 (a v1 share is a valid store-bound share), which is safe because a share is stored only inside a CostAllocation@2.

changes.name: CostAllocation
changes.reason: CostAllocation@2: schemaVersion 2 over AllocationShare@2 shares.

changes.name: EventEnvelope
changes.reason: EventEnvelope@2: schemaVersion 2; the v1 payloadRef is an ArtifactRef and event payloads are not artifacts. An additive event registry (docs/contracts/event-registry.json) replaces the closed aggregate enum; payloads carry IDs and statuses only; payload and payloadRef (an EventPayloadRef) are nulled together; streamPosition is sealed per viewer. A v1 envelope is not a valid EventEnvelope@2.

changes.name: ResourceRef
changes.reason: ResourceRef v1.1: kind gains store, the connected store as a whole ({kind: store, id: storeId, storeId, connectionId}; storeId and connectionId non-null by schema, id = storeId checked in code by validateCurrentDefinition), the resource every catalogue permission is evaluated on. A superset of v1: every v1 ResourceRef is valid, and a v1 reader refuses kind store, so it fails closed.

changes.name: Scope
changes.reason: Scope v1.1: resources are v1.1 ResourceRefs, so a scope can name the store resource; nothing else changes. A superset of v1: every v1 Scope is valid.

changes.name: Grant
changes.reason: Grant v1.1: its scope is the v1.1 Scope, so the store-link template (ADR-0022 item 3) can be stored and re-read; nothing else changes. A superset of v1: every stored v1 grant is valid, and kernels read grants only through validateCurrentDefinition.

changes.name: AgentInstallation
changes.reason: AgentInstallation v1.1: its scope is the v1.1 Scope, so the Listings installation (ADR-0022 item 3) can be scoped to exactly its store resource and the agent kernel can read it; nothing else changes. A superset of v1: every v1 AgentInstallation is valid, a v1 reader refuses a store-scoped installation and so fails closed, and validateCurrentDefinition applies the store rule to every resource its scope names.

changes.name: CriteriaList
changes.reason: A declared superset of v1: an item may add key (GoalKey) and measure (GoalMeasure or null); a measured item needs its key and at most 3 items are measured. Keys are unique and a measure's dueAt is no later than its goal record's, checked in code (validateCurrentDefinition). Every v1 list is valid; a v1 reader refuses a measured item.

changes.name: Goal
changes.reason: A declared superset of v1: optional dueAt (a dated project) and areaTemplateId (an Everyday work area or Quick tasks), never both, and successCriteria as the v1.1 CriteriaList. Every v1 goal is valid; a v1 reader refuses a measured goal, a dueAt or an areaTemplateId.

changes.name: workspace.routine.configure.input
changes.reason: A routine or recurring task names its goal record (goalId), and an alert also the goal's key (goalKey), so repeating work lives in its project (ADR-0033 item 8). A v1 body lacks both and is not a valid v1.1 body.
